title: BrowserDetailsResource
description: Contains details on the browser for a standalone 3DS Authentication.

accept_header.description: The HTTP accept headers from the cardholder's browser.

color_depth.description: The color depth of the cardholder’s screen.

ip_address.description: The IP address of the browser.

java_enabled.description: The cardholder browser’s ability to execute Java.

javascript_enabled.description: The cardholder browser’s ability to execute JavaScript.

language.description: An IETF BCP 47 language tag representing the browser language.

screen_height.description: The total height of the cardholder’s screen in pixels.

screen_width.description: The total width of the cardholder’s screen in pixels.

timezone_offset.description: The time difference between UTC time and the local time of the cardholder’s browser, in minutes.
